description: Artifact contract for architecture decision output produced by Architect agents.

statusSemantics.passDefinition: The decision traces to approved requirements; system boundaries are explicit; material alternatives and tradeoffs are evaluated; consequences and risks are documented; and no unresolved requirement prevents implementation.
statusSemantics.failDefinition: The proposed architecture demonstrably violates an approved requirement or constraint.
statusSemantics.blockedDefinition: A requirement, quality attribute, constraint, or dependency fact necessary to make the architecture decision is unavailable, missing, or unverifiable.
